capabilities: Recognize folders containing index.html or index.htm and show them as one document row in the Files pane
Run local HTML with JavaScript, styles, media and Canvas in a separate browser renderer
Search course names, titles and static entry-page text from the course picker
Reload changed course resources while preserving reading position where possible
Copy deep links into Markdown notes or open a course in the default browser
disambiguation: Not an e-learning or course-authoring tool; 'coursebook' just names its presentation of any local HTML project folder as one document.
extras: As of November 9, 2026 the plugin is not yet in the community installation registry, so manual installation is required. Desktop only; manually tested on macOS only. The README discloses that local course scripts execute in the renderer (with sandboxing but no content audit), the search index only covers static entry-page text, and live refresh resets in-page state.
problem: Obsidian shows self-contained HTML projects (index.html plus scripts, styles and assets) as scattered files, and viewing them as one clickable document otherwise needs conversion, a local server, or the Web Viewer core plugin.

relations.evidence: Related projects include Local HTML View for opening HTML files
File Bundles for declared file dependencies, and NestNote for Markdown document folders
File Bundles for declared file dependencies, and NestNote for Markdown document folders

summary: Presents local HTML project folders as single interactive documents in the Files pane, with course search, in-page search, and live refresh.
